note: Post-run decomposition only; not preregistered candidate evidence.
mechanism: The universal ratchet affected only PRIMARY/SECONDARY. PRIMARY contribution improved all four evaluated window/grid combinations; recent 1s degradation came from SECONDARY ratchet exits.
decision_use: May justify freezing a PRIMARY-only ratchet candidate in a later numbered experiment; cannot be treated as promotion evidence because this decomposition was selected after Experiment 39 outcomes were visible.
